title: Exoplanet Transit Simulator — Interactive Light Curve | Space Atlas
description: Use an interactive exoplanet transit simulator to move a planet across its star and read the light-curve dip astronomers use to detect distant worlds.
ogTitle: Exoplanet Transit Simulator — Interactive Light Curve
ogDescription: Drag a planet across a star and watch the brightness dip that's how most exoplanets are actually found.
jsonldName: Exoplanet Transit Simulator — Interactive Light Curve
jsonldDescription: An interactive simulation of the exoplanet transit detection method, showing a star's brightness curve dipping as an orbiting planet passes in front of it.
